files.body:
# hollowmere/v1's module path, explained -- deploy status deliberately NOT recorded here.
#
# This file ships on chain exactly as written the moment hollowmere/v1 is deployed, and a
# realm cannot be edited afterwards. garden/v2/gnomod.toml said "NOT deployed" in this
# same spot, was deployed, and now carries that false line permanently on chain -- see
# that file's own comment for the correction and the lesson. Not repeating it here:
# whether and when this has been deployed lives in the repo root's DECISIONS.md and
# STATUS.md, both of which can still be edited after the fact, unlike this file.
#
# The module path below mirrors garden/garden.gno and garden/v2/garden.gno's own
# placeholder style: the deploy key's own address namespace, not a name, because
# `gnotchi` is not registerable today (r/sys/names, team-held controller -- see
# realms/garden/NOTES.md). Nothing here implies a decision about whether `gnotchi`
# namespace registration has happened by the time this is actually deployed -- whoever
# deploys this should re-check that this path is still right first.
module = "gno.land/r/g1r4aw43kagaaquhegxw6xr346h9f2qu2ezf0jar/hollowmere/v1"
gno = "0.9"
